rows.label: FACT
rows.text: L2 runs backwards on this tape: the control's narrative class (the only class the 5 % trades) is its worst, 776 trades, 20 % win, +0.083 SOL mean; the three banned classes are its best: dev 178 trades 59 % +0.270, tech 146 trades 51 % +0.288, celebrity 34 trades 59 % +0.281. The control's mean rises monotonically with the creator's buy at create: 0 SOL +0.034, under 0.5 +0.096, under 1 +0.212, under 2 +0.228, under 5 +0.313, 5 and over +0.315
